review_notes: Reviewed all 61 lines, the underlying definitions, downstream uses, and Finset's filter simp rules. One missing membership interface is supported by an actual downstream use. No Lean execution was performed; the proposed addition is untested.

findings.excerpt:
noncomputable def biasedPrimeBand (A : Set ℕ) (N : ℕ) (T δ : ℝ) (t : ℕ → ℤ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (logPrimeBand T).filter fun p => δ ≤ |residueTestMean (tailSupport A N p) (quadraticResidueTest p (t p))|
findings.problem: There is no canonical simp rule for membership in biasedPrimeBand. The desired normal form of `p ∈ biasedPrimeBand A N T δ t` is band membership conjoined with the bias inequality. Finset.mem_filter supplies this normalization only after exposing the definition; the downstream hQbias proof consequently accesses the filter representation directly.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp] theorem mem_biasedPrimeBand {A : Set ℕ} {N p : ℕ} {T δ : ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℤ} : p ∈ biasedPrimeBand A N T δ t ↔ p ∈ logPrimeBand T ∧ δ ≤ |residueTestMean (tailSupport A N p) (quadraticResidueTest p (t p))|`, proved by unfolding biasedPrimeBand and applying Finset.mem_filter. Annotate this membership theorem, not the definition.
findings.benefit: Provides a stable simplification interface for downstream membership hypotheses without globally expanding biasedPrimeBand inside sums. The orientation removes the named membership expression and introduces no reverse rule. It requires no positivity or nonemptiness assumptions, so empty supports and arbitrary thresholds remain covered.

evidence.excerpt:
have hQbias : ∀ p ∈ Q, δ / 4 ≤ |residueTestMean (tailSupport A N p) (quadraticResidueTest p (t p))| :=
    fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2

@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_filter {s : Finset α} {a : α} : a ∈ s.filter p ↔ a ∈ s ∧ p a :=
  Multiset.mem_filter
